image_description: A close-up, high-resolution shot of an adult bison's head and shoulder hump in profile, facing left. In the bottom right corner, the top of a calf's head is visible, nuzzling or resting against the adult. The background is a soft-focus green field.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is visibly massive and broad. One horn is clearly visible, exhibiting the characteristic short, upward-curving shape typical of bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinctive long, shaggy hair hangs from the chin and throat area, matching the 'beard' description.
The visible eye is dark and surrounded by dense fur.
No prominent ears are visible; they appear small and buried within the thick forelock and head fur, consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The shoulder hump is extremely prominent and rises significantly higher than the rest of the visible back, indicating the massive build.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fur texture is visibly coarse, shaggy, and dark brown/black, concentrated heavily on the head and shoulders.
The image is a close-up of the head and shoulders; the hindquarters are outside the frame.

Legs and hooves are not visible in this tight crop.
